mergedParams.userDescription: Text subtly integrated, motion-tracked to a surface in the video. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Motion-Tracked Typokinetic Text on Video Surfaces

prompts.prompt: Create a typokinetics preset that simulates motion-tracked text subtly attached to surfaces in the video, like a film editor would track text to a wall or floor. The text should appear to be part of the 3D space, with perspective distortion that matches camera movement. Use a BaseLayout container with 'absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none' to overlay the entire video. Implement TextAtom components for each caption word, applying custom transform3d effects that simulate perspective tracking. The text should have subtle depth - not flat overlays but dimensionally integrated elements. Add a slight ease-out animation as text 'locks onto' surfaces, with micro-adjustments that simulate real motion tracking imperfections. Include a subtle drop shadow that changes based on the supposed light source position. The typography should feel environmental, like it belongs in the scene rather than floating above it.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='absolute inset-0' containing individual TextAtom components positioned absolutely. Each word gets transform: perspective(1000px) rotateX/Y based on surface angle. Use generic effects with AnimationRange for smooth perspective transitions over 0.3s with ease-out. Apply CSS filter for dynamic shadows: filter: drop-shadow(2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)). Add subtle translateZ for depth layering. Use will-change: transform for GPU acceleration. Implement micro-movements via secondary effect ranges with 0.1s intervals simulating tracking adjustments. Caption data word timing drives appearance with 0.05s stagger between words. Consider using internal effect preset 'surface-lock' for reusable tracking behavior.

prompts.prompt: Design a kinetic typography preset where text flows like liquid motion graphics, inspired by After Effects text animators. Words should cascade in with physics-based motion - think of text as having weight and momentum. Create a gravity-influenced entrance where words fall from above, bounce slightly on impact, then settle into place with dampened oscillation. Use spring physics for natural motion. The text should have varying velocities based on word importance from caption metadata - impactful words fall faster and hit harder. Add motion blur during rapid movement phases. Include subtle rotation during the fall for dynamic feel. Text should stack naturally if multiple lines are needed, with each line affecting the next like dominoes.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Use BaseLayout with containerProps.className='flex flex-col items-center justify-end h-full pb-8' for bottom alignment. Each TextAtom uses transform: translateY with spring easing. Initial translateY: -150vh, animating to 0 over 0.8s. Add bounce effect via multiple AnimationRange keyframes: 0%, -10%, 5%, -2%, 0% positions. Apply blur filter during motion: filter: blur(2px) transitioning to blur(0). Rotation via transform: rotate with random -15deg to 15deg initial values. Use caption metadata.impact to multiply animation duration (high impact = faster fall). Stack lines with gap-2 spacing. Add will-change: transform, filter for performance. Consider waveform effects if audio present for bass-triggered bounces.

prompts.prompt: Build a glitch-inspired typokinetics preset that treats text like corrupted video data. Text should flicker into existence with digital artifacts - horizontal scan lines, RGB channel splits, and data moshing effects. Think of how a video editor would create datamosh transitions. Words materialize through interference patterns, with random character reveals simulating data packets arriving asynchronously. Add intermittent position jumps and brief opacity flashes. Include chromatic aberration on text edges. The timing should feel erratic but purposeful - not random noise but controlled chaos. More important words (keywords from metadata) should have more dramatic glitch effects.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden'. TextAtom components with custom CSS filters for RGB splits: filter: drop-shadow(-2px 0 0 red) drop-shadow(2px 0 0 cyan). Use generic effects with rapid AnimationRange changes: opacity flickering between 0-1 over 0.05s intervals. Position glitches via translateX/Y with random offsets ±20px. Implement scan lines using ::before pseudo-element with linear-gradient and animation. Character reveal via clip-path: inset() animations. Use caption metadata.keyword to trigger enhanced glitch intensity. Add mix-blend-mode: screen for digital feel. Performance: use transform3d(0,0,0) for layer promotion, limit filter complexity.

prompts.prompt: Create an elegant minimal typokinetics preset where text emerges through subtle material design principles. Words should materialize like ink bleeding through paper - starting as a small point and expanding outward with organic flow. Think of this as editing with masked reveals in Premiere Pro. Each word begins as a tiny dot that expands into legible text through a radial reveal. Add slight paper texture overlay. The animation should breathe - text scales up slightly beyond target size then settles back (overshoot). Include subtle letter-spacing animations that compress then expand to normal. Typography should feel premium and refined, with smooth 60fps motion throughout.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center p-8 gap-4'. TextAtom with initial scale(0) and clip-path: circle(0% at center). Animate to scale(1.05) then scale(1) over 0.6s with cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1). Clip-path animates to circle(100% at center). Letter-spacing from -0.1em to 0.05em to 0em. Add subtle texture via background-image with low opacity. Use backdrop-filter: blur(1px) for depth. Implement with generic effects using precise AnimationRange timing. Consider internal effect preset 'ink-bleed' for the reveal pattern. Word timing from caption data with 0.1s overlap between words for fluid motion.

prompts.prompt: Develop a parallax typokinetics preset mimicking multi-plane camera techniques from traditional animation. Text layers should move at different speeds creating depth illusion. Foreground text moves faster, background slower, simulating camera dolly movements. Think of how Disney multiplane cameras work - each text layer is a separate plane. Add atmospheric perspective where distant text is slightly blurred and lower contrast. Include subtle floating motion like text suspended in space. Words should drift independently on micro-orbits. The overall effect should feel cinematic and three-dimensional without being overtly 3D.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Multiple BaseLayout containers with z-index layering. Foreground: containerProps.className='absolute inset-0 z-30', midground z-20, background z-10. Each layer has different transform: translateX speeds via generic effects. Foreground moves 100%, midground 60%, background 30% of base value. Add translateY sine wave oscillation with different frequencies per layer. Background text: filter: blur(1px) opacity(0.7). Use transform3d for GPU layers. Implement floating via secondary AnimationRange with 3-4s loops. Caption words distributed across layers based on metadata.impact. Consider fitDurationTo='children' for dynamic timing. Add will-change: transform for all moving elements.

prompts.prompt: Design a handwritten typokinetics preset that simulates real-time writing animation. Text should appear as if being drawn by an invisible hand, with natural speed variations and pen pressure effects. Think of rotoscoping handwriting in After Effects. Each letter draws on sequentially with realistic timing - faster for simple strokes, slower for complex curves. Add slight shake to simulate hand tremor. Include pen lift animations between words. The stroke should vary in opacity/thickness based on writing speed. Cursive fonts work best but system fonts should adapt too. Add paper grain texture and slight ink bleed effects for authenticity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-gray-50 to-gray-100'. TextAtom with SVG stroke animation via stroke-dasharray and stroke-dashoffset. Calculate path length dynamically, animate dashoffset from full length to 0. Vary animation duration per character complexity (0.1-0.3s). Add slight transform: rotate(±0.5deg) and translate(±1px) for hand shake. Implement stroke-width variations via multiple AnimationRange keyframes. Use mask-image for ink texture. Between words, scale(0.95) to scale(1) simulating pen lift. Caption word timing drives sequential reveal. Consider AudioAtom integration for writing sound effects synchronized with strokes.

prompts.prompt: Build a reactive typokinetics preset where text responds to assumed video motion like a heads-up display in action films. Text should auto-stabilize against camera shake, maintaining readability during intense scenes. Think of how HUD elements work in films like Iron Man. Text anchors to screen edges but shifts slightly to avoid important visual elements. Add scan line effects and slight digital flicker. Include data visualization elements - progress bars, brackets, technical readouts. Text should pulse with urgency during high-intensity moments (use audio analysis if available). The overall feel should be tactical and responsive.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='fixed inset-0 p-4' and pointer-events-none. TextAtom components positioned with absolute top-4 left-4 or bottom-4 right-4 anchoring. Implement stabilization via inverse transform animations - if assumed shake is translateX(10px), apply translateX(-10px). Add HUD styling: text-shadow: 0 0 3px currentColor for glow. Include ::before/::after pseudo-elements for brackets/lines. Use waveform effects for audio-reactive pulsing on bass hits. Add CSS animations for scan lines via linear-gradient backgrounds. Performance: use transform-origin for pivot points, contain: layout for optimization. If audio available, use fetcher for beat detection to trigger urgency modes.

prompts.prompt: Create an organic growth typokinetics preset where text emerges like living organisms. Words should grow from seed points, branching out with vine-like tendrils that form letters. Think of time-lapse plant growth footage editing. Each word starts as a small sprout that rapidly extends, curves, and branches into letterforms. Add slight breathing animation post-growth. Include particle effects suggesting pollen or spores. The growth should feel natural with acceleration and deceleration phases. Letters should interconnect subtly, creating a living typography ecosystem. More important words grow larger with more elaborate branching.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative w-full h-full overflow-visible'. TextAtom with custom clip-path animations simulating organic growth. Start with clip-path: polygon creating sprout shape, animate through multiple polygon states to final letter shape. Use 8-10 AnimationRange keyframes for smooth organic motion over 1.2s. Add scale breathing: scale(1) to scale(1.02) with 3s loop. Implement tendril connections via absolutely positioned ShapeAtom elements with SVG paths. Use filter: blur(0.5px) during growth, sharp when complete. Caption metadata.impact determines growth complexity. Consider using LottieAtom for particle effects if complex animations needed. Transform-origin at base for natural growth pivot.

prompts.prompt: Develop a perspective warp typokinetics preset that treats text like it's painted on elastic surfaces. Words stretch and contract as if the surface beneath is being manipulated. Think of mesh warp effects in After Effects. Text should ripple when appearing, with wave distortions propagating through the letters. Add rubber band physics - text overshoots target position then snaps back. Include subtle secondary animations like individual letter wobbles. The distortion should feel tactile and physical. Create depth by having words at different distortion phases simultaneously, like waves passing through fabric.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='relative flex items-center justify-center w-full h-full'. TextAtom with CSS transform: matrix3d for complex distortions. Implement wave effect via scaleX/scaleY animations with sine wave patterns. Initial scaleX: 0.3, scaleY: 1.5, animating to 1,1 with spring easing. Add skewX/skewY for additional warping: ±15deg oscillating to 0. Letter-level effects via span wrapping with individual animation delays. Use generic effects with multiple AnimationRange arrays for compound movements. Rubber band via cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55). Performance: use will-change: transform, limit to 3 simultaneous transforms. Caption word timing creates wave propagation with 0.08s delays.

prompts.prompt: Design a split-screen typokinetics preset inspired by comic book panel transitions. Text appears within dynamic panels that split, merge, and reorganize. Think of how video editors create split-screen effects with animated masks. Each word or phrase gets its own panel that slides in from screen edges. Panels should have comic-style borders with slight rotation for dynamic composition. Add motion lines and speed effects during transitions. Include panel zoom effects for emphasis. The layout should adapt - single panel for one word, split for multiple, with smooth transitions between states. More dramatic words trigger panel shakes or explosive reveals.
prompts.technicalSpecs: BaseLayout with containerProps.className='grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2 p-4' with dynamic column adjustment. Each panel is a nested BaseLayout with containerProps.className='border-4 border-black relative overflow-hidden'. TextAtom centered within panels. Panels slide via translateX/Y from ±100% to 0. Add rotate(±2deg) for dynamic angles. Motion lines via ::before with repeating-linear-gradient angled 45deg. Implement panel transitions using generic effects with clip-path: polygon animations. Zoom emphasis via scale(1.2) with 0.2s duration. Use caption metadata to determine panel count and arrangement. Consider scene type with sequential panel reveals. Add box-shadow for depth. Performance: use transform3d(0,0,0) for layer creation.
